scenes.en: With eye pain? This is urgent.
scenes.say: Rainbow rings around lights, with eye pain? This can be an emergency.

scenes.en: Fluid inside the eye can suddenly stop draining. Pressure shoots up.
scenes.ta: கண்ணின் உள்ளே திரவம் வெளியேறாமல் அழுத்தம் உயரும்
scenes.say: Fluid inside the eye normally drains out. In some people, the drain can suddenly get blocked, and the eye pressure shoots up.

scenes.en: Halos or rainbow rings around lights, with blurred vision
scenes.say: Sign one. Halos or rainbow rings around lights, with blurred vision.

scenes.en: Severe eye pain and headache, often on one side
scenes.say: Sign two. Severe eye pain and headache, often on one side.

scenes.en: Red eye with nausea or vomiting
scenes.say: Sign three. A red eye, with nausea or vomiting. People often mistake it for a migraine or a stomach upset.

scenes.en: This is acute angle-closure glaucoma. Without quick treatment, sight can be lost for good.
scenes.ta: உடனே சிகிச்சை இல்லாவிட்டால் பார்வை நிரந்தரமாகப் பாதிக்கலாம்
scenes.say: Did you know? This is called acute angle closure glaucoma. Without quick treatment, it can cause permanent vision loss.

scenes.en: Same day. Risk is higher after 40 and in long-sighted people.
scenes.say: See an eye specialist urgently, the same day. And after forty, get regular eye checks. Book an eye test.
